name: Conditional Predictive Gain Graph (CPGG) - design for this study, not an established algorithm

fx_input_policy_options.lag1: primary: FX-derived inputs (returns, momentum, FX vol, FX-vol regime, loss volatility) use rows <= t-1; the 12:00 H.10 rate of the decision date is not an input (consistent with the 11:30 feature cutoff)
fx_input_policy_options.same_day: sensitivity only: same-day 12:00 FX is an input; assumes a real-time market feed observes the noon rate at decision time (NOT the FRED/H.10 publication time)

split.legacy_rule: rows 10.. of the merged PIT panel; train = first 60% of (n - 10), validation = next 20%, test = rest (arcfx_selector_compare.Data)

message_model.masks_per_date: one mask per (date, receiver) per step, resampled every step

aux_rule: 3 selectors of the chosen config on 3 time blocks of B; add a candidate only if all three estimated gains > 0 (fixed before running)

synthetic.pass_A: SNR 1.0 and 0.3: forced-edge loss gain >= 50% of oracle gain and block-bootstrap 95% CI of (own - forced) > 0
synthetic.pass_B: CHF->JPY selection rate higher on regime than non-regime days (block bootstrap CI low > 0), per selector
synthetic.pass_C: noise source selection rate for JPY <= 10%; mean estimated gain of duplicate given S={CHF} <= 0.5 x estimated gain of CHF given empty set

evaluation.primary: date-wise mean over 10 currencies of prediction loss (Huber + eta BCE); paired difference
evaluation.H1: Dense residual vs Own-only on C
evaluation.H2: Selected residual (main rule) vs Dense residual on C

fix_attempts.failure: synthetic A SNR1.0: forced/oracle gain ratio 0.006; CHF message slope 0.003 vs injected 1.11; early stop at epoch 1 (~9 steps/epoch)
fix_attempts.diagnosis: optimisation + structure: pair-specific coefficient only reachable via embedding x trunk interaction, shared bias path averages to 0 across pairs; too few steps before early stopping
fix_attempts.change: message: add zero-initialised pair-specific coefficient table to beta; lr 1e-3->3e-3, batch 128->32, patience 10->20. own: batch 128->32, patience 10->20
fix_attempts.probe: lr3e-3/b32/p20 alone: slope 0.016; pair table alone: slope 0.008; both: slope 1.14, ratio 0.89

fix_attempts.failure: attempt 1: A SNR1.0 passed (ratio 0.89) but SNR0.3 failed (ratio 0.11); message checkpoint stayed at epoch 1
fix_attempts.diagnosis: trace (no early stop): CHF->JPY slope reaches the injected 0.61 by epoch 4-5 and JPY val loss falls, but messages of the 9 receivers without signal raise their val loss from epoch 1, so the full-mask inner-val loss never improves; stronger weight decay / pair lr alone (8 probes) did not change this
fix_attempts.change: message checkpoint criterion = minus the selectable gain on the inner validation rows (last 15% of A OOF rows): sum over (receiver, sender) of max(0, mean single-add loss gain at the empty set); lr 3e-3 -> 1e-3 with 10x lr on the pair table
fix_attempts.probe: selectable-gain checkpoint: SNR1.0 ratio 0.88, SNR0.3 0.77, SNR0.1 0.49
